record.paper_title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
record.original_question: Can one apply or develop bosonization, or bosonization-like constructions, that convert the graded and braided paraparticle Hopf structures into ordinary Hopf structures with trivial braiding while preserving equivalent representation theory?

evidence.quote: 3rd Research Objective: Apply or develop suitable bosonization or bosonization-like techniques to obtain ordinary Hopf structures, with no grading and with trivial braiding, possessing equivalent representation theories.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. Let $G$ be an abelian group equipped with a bicharacter $\beta: G\times G \to k^\times$ (over a field $k$ of characteristic $0$), and let $\mathcal{H}_\beta$ denote the braided monoidal category of $G$-graded vector spaces with the symmetric/quasi-symmetric braiding $\tau_\beta(x\otimes y)=\beta(|x|,|y|)\,y\otimes x$ on homogeneous elements. A paraparticle Hopf algebra is a Hopf algebra object $H$ in $\mathcal{H}_\beta$: that is, a $G$-graded associative unital algebra equipped with a coproduct $\Delta:H\to H\underline{\otimes}H$, counit, and antipode that are morphisms in $\mathcal{H}_\beta$, where the tensor product $\underline{\otimes}$ uses the braiding $\tau_\beta$. Standard examples include the parabosonic algebra $P_B$, the parafermionic algebra $P_F$, and the relative parabose/parafermi set $P_{BF}$, each carrying such a graded braided Hopf structure.
        
Recall Majid–Radford bosonization: given a braided Hopf algebra $B$ in the category of (Yetter–Drinfeld or comodule) modules over a quasitriangular Hopf algebra $K$, one forms the smash biproduct $B \rtimes K$, an ordinary (ungraded, unbraided) Hopf algebra whose category of (suitable) modules is monoidally equivalent to that of $B$ in the braided category.

Problem. Develop or apply a bosonization (or bosonization-like) construction that, for each paraparticle Hopf algebra $H$ in $\mathcal{H}_\beta$ (in particular for $H = P_B$, $P_F$, and $P_{BF}$), produces an ordinary Hopf algebra $\widehat{H}$ over $k$ (no grading, trivial braiding) such that the representation theory of $H$ as a braided Hopf algebra in $\mathcal{H}_\beta$ is equivalent—as a monoidal category of representations—to the representation theory of $\widehat{H}$ as an ordinary Hopf algebra. Specifically, exhibit such a $\widehat{H}$ explicitly for the parabosonic, parafermionic, and relative parabose–parafermi algebras, and prove the equivalence of their (module or comodule) representation categories.
artifact.status_search_result: General Majid–Radford bosonization theory converts braided Hopf algebras (in suitable categories, including super-Hopf algebras and graded/braided ones over abelian group bicharacters) into ordinary Hopf algebras with equivalent representation theory. However, no source located explicitly carries out and verifies this program for the specific paraparticle Hopf algebras (parabosonic, parafermionic, relative parabose–parafermi set) with a published proof of representation-theoretic equivalence; the status of this concrete objective therefore appears unresolved in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Cross Products by Braided Groups and Bosonization (Majid)
status_evidence.snippet: Every braided Hopf algebra in a suitable category can be converted to an equivalent ordinary Hopf algebra via bosonization.
status_evidence.claim: General bosonization framework exists that converts braided Hopf algebras to ordinary Hopf algebras with equivalent representation theory.

status_evidence.title: Gradings, Braidings, Representations, Paraparticles: Some Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as a research objective the application/development of bosonization-like techniques to obtain ordinary Hopf structures equivalent to paraparticle ones.
status_evidence.claim: The specific paraparticle case is posed as an open research objective.

status_evidence.title: A note on bosonization
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bosonization in the context of graded and braided Hopf algebras relevant to parastatistics.
status_evidence.claim: Bosonization-related constructions for paraparticle/graded settings are under active investigation but not fully resolved for all paraparticle algebras.
